s1.title: An AI partner that's always on
s1.lede: Marketing, publishing, the small chores of running a shop: say it once, hand it over.

s2.title: It works on its own cloud computer
s2.lede: Douyin, Laike, Xiaohongshu: it opens the sites on its own cloud desktop to publish and pull numbers. You only see results.

s3.title: Results and reminders come back to your phone
s3.lede: Finished videos, tidy numbers, anything that needs your call: all delivered here.

composer.title: How to be clear
composer.body: Type / to add context, @ to reference a file from Resources; "More" on the right uploads material or a screenshot.

projects.title: Projects and chats
projects.body: Chats are grouped by project; one project for one ongoing thing.

resources.title: Resources
resources.body: Files it produced and material you uploaded live here.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.body: Task results, system reminders and official notices.

authCenter.title: Authorizations
authCenter.body: Once you link Douyin and other accounts it can publish and read your numbers. Status and expiry live here.

skills.title: Skills
skills.body: Give it abilities, like making videos or posting to Douyin.

cron.title: Scheduled tasks
cron.body: Have it do something every day or every week.

billing.title: Plans
billing.body: Credits and plans; check usage here.

desktop.title: Cloud desktop
desktop.body: Open this workspace's cloud computer to watch it work; tick "Allow control" to take over.

panelEntry.title: Work panel
panelEntry.body: See its cloud desktop, browser, files and changes waiting for your review.

desktopControl.title: Taking over is this checkbox
desktopControl.body: The computer it uses to work the web for you. On a captcha or login, tick "Allow control" to act directly; untick when done to hand it back. Unticked, you only watch.

notify.title: Only when you're away
notify.body: Finished tasks and things that need your call are pushed when the phone is locked or you're in another app. Never while you're here.
points: A video or a report is ready
It hit a captcha and needs you

takeover.title: It's stuck and needs you
takeover.body: It can't solve captchas. Follow the three steps below; it waits the whole time.
steps: Pass the check on the cloud desktop
Come back here and tap "Done, continue"

authCenter.title: Link your Douyin account first
authCenter.body: Once linked it can publish videos and read your numbers. Scan → confirm in the Douyin app → come back and see "Authorized".

settings.replayHint: Back to home and replay the welcome and every hint

inbox.title: Three kinds of messages land here
inbox.body: Task results open the conversation; system reminders cover expiring authorizations and takeovers; official notices are features and announcements.

cronEmpty.body: Say in any chat "every morning at nine, tidy up yesterday's numbers for me" and it sets up the schedule; results go back to that chat.

skillsEmpty.body: Skills are abilities you give it: making short videos, posting to Douyin, reading your numbers.

resourcesEmpty.body: Files here come from two places: what chats produce (videos, reports, copy) and what you upload. Type @ in a message to reference one.

credits.title: Credits
credits.body: Videos, images and chat all draw credits by usage. Tap here for usage details and plans.

question.title: It's waiting for your answer
question.body: It stays paused until you answer. Pick an option or write your own.

plan.title: Confirm before it runs
plan.body: These are the steps it intends to take. Run as planned, ask for a rewrite, or edit.

permission.title: This step needs your nod
permission.body: "Allow" lets this one through; "Always allow" stops asking. Unsure? Deny.

videoReview.title: Review the cut before posting
videoReview.body: Watch, change lines, regenerate any segment here; publish when you're happy.
